map.囊胚 Gardner 评分 = 扩张度（1–6）+ 内细胞团 ICM（A/B/C: Blastocyst Gardner score = expansion (1–6) + inner cell mass ICM (A/B/C) + trophectoderm TE (A/B/C); ICM/TE scored as A=3, B=2, C=1; AA top-quality, sum ≥5 good, sum=4 usable, sum<4 suboptimal; expansion <3 is not fully expanded.
map.提示：ICM 决定胎儿，TE 决定胎盘。TE 质量对着床率影响显著。扩张度≥3: Note: ICM determines the fetus, TE determines the placenta. TE quality strongly affects implantation rate. Blastocysts with expansion ≥3 are suitable for biopsy and freezing. For learning reference only.
map.编码 4AA：ICM 与 TE 均 A 级，优质囊胚，优先移植/冷冻。: Code 4AA: ICM and TE both grade A, top-quality blastocyst, priority transfer/freezing.
map.3BB：可用胚胎，着床潜能中等，可作次选。: 3BB: usable embryo, moderate implantation potential, can be a secondary choice.
map.三部分含义？: What do the three parts mean?
map.扩张度(1–6)＋内细胞团(A–C)＋滋养层(A–C)；数字越大越扩张、字母越前: Expansion (1–6) + inner cell mass (A–C) + trophectoderm (A–C); higher number = more expanded, earlier letter = better.
map.扩张≥4 且 ICM/TE 为 A 或 B 的囊胚着床率最高。: Blastocysts with expansion ≥4 and ICM/TE of A or B have the highest implantation rate.
